用途: T-034 ヒーローの装飾画像
prompt: Create a premium 3D-rendered hero artwork for a Japanese software developer portfolio with deep midnight navy and luminous electric cyan art direction. Landscape 3:2 composition, at least 1536px wide, transparent background and clean alpha edges. A sleek realistic open dark metallic laptop in three-quarter view, floating slightly above a thin elliptical neon cyan orbital ring. Laptop screen has a sophisticated dark coding workspace with tiny abstract code marks at left and a luminous cyan-to-indigo wireframe terrain visualization at right; nothing legible, no branding. Three translucent beveled glass holographic panels float above and behind the laptop: left a sound waveform, upper middle a small luminous 3D geometric cube, right an abstract blue wireframe landscape. Keep panels asymmetrical, not a dashboard grid. Refined cyan rim lighting, subtle blue reflections, convincing materials and cinematic depth. Modest violet accent confined to the wireframe display, cyan overwhelmingly primary. Subject fills most of canvas with 8% clear margins, composition oriented so laptop points slightly left. Glowing ring and small light sparks support the physical scene. Ultra clean commercially polished futuristic product visualization. Every piece is isolated on transparent background, no room, no floor rectangle, no dark rectangular backdrop, no UI buttons or labels, no text, no logo, no watermark, no human or anime character. Avoid overly bright white bloom or large cloudy haze. Intended to sit naturally on #03121f website background.
